## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The `--exclude` flag should read its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can configure exclusions through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by name during archive collection and logs skipped paths at INFO level. It documents the flag and adds parser, collection, and archive-content tests.

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the archive includes `build.log` because the parser hardcodes `default=[]`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says every new flag must “take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure options through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to omit.
